description_en: Queries the details of a hybrid cloud domain name
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-resource-detail --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --domain www.00000.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudResourceDetail

parameters.help_en:

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page

The CNAME assigned by WAF to the domain name.

FocusHttps.description_en:

false: HTTPS forced redirect is not enabled
FocusHttps.description_zh:
是否开启HTTPS的强制跳转。取值：

HTTP协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回

share: shared cluster.

要使用的防护资源类型。取值：

TLSVersion.description_en:

tlsv1

tlsv1.2

tlsv1

tlsv1.1

tlsv1.2

XffHeaderMode.description_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: No Layer 7 proxy is deployed before WAF.

1: WAF reads the first value in the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header as the client IP address.

2: WAF reads the value of a custom field in the request header as the client IP address.

3: WAF reads the Client IP from the Proxy Protocol header as the client IP address
XffHeaderMode.description_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

3：表示WAF读取Proxy Protocol头中的Client IP作为客户端IP

XffHeaders.description_en:
The list of custom fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2, which indicates that WAF reads the custom field value you specified in the request header as the client IP address
XffHeaders.description_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数

items.description_en:
The list of custom fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2, which indicates that WAF reads the custom field value you specified in the request header as the client IP address
items.description_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数

items.description_en: The custom port configuration. By default, the port is the same as the listening port

http：表示 HTTP 协议。
https：表示 HTTPS 协议

Backends.description_en: The IP address of the origin server or the domain name used for back-to-origin
Backends.description_zh: 源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名

CnameEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable public cloud disaster recovery. Valid values:

true: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

false: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled
CnameEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾

ConnectTimeout.description_en: The connection timeout period. Unit: milliseconds
ConnectTimeout.description_zh: 连接超时时间：单位毫秒

FocusHttpBackend.description_en:
Indicates whether forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled. Valid values:

true: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled.

false: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is not enabled
FocusHttpBackend.description_zh:
是否开启强制HTTP回源。取值：

true：表示开启强制HTTP回源。

false：表示不开启强制HTTP回源

Keepalive.description_en:
Indicates whether keep-alive connections are enabled. Valid values:

true (default): Keep-alive connections are enabled.

false: Keep-alive connections are not enabled
Keepalive.description_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true（默认）：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接

KeepaliveRequests.description_en:
The number of requests that reuse keep-alive connections. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

After keep-alive connections are enabled, this parameter specifies how many keep-alive connections are reused
KeepaliveRequests.description_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en: The idle timeout period of keep-alive connections
KeepaliveTimeout.description_zh: 长连接的空闲超时时间

Loadbalance.description_en:
The load balancing algorithm used for back-to-origin. Valid values:

iphash: IP Hash algorithm.

roundRobin: round-robin algorithm.

leastTime: Least Time algorithm
Loadbalance.description_zh:
回源时采用的负载均衡算法。取值：

iphash：表示IP Hash算法。

roundRobin：表示轮询算法。

leastTime：表示Least Time算法

ProxyProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the client source IP preservation feature is enabled.

true: The client source IP preservation feature is enabled. After this feature is enabled, the backend service can view the originating IP address of the client.
false: The client source IP preservation feature is not enabled
ProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源 IP 功能。

true：开启了保持客户端源 IP 功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始 IP 地址。
false：未开启保持客户端源 IP 功能

ReadTimeout.description_en: The read timeout period of the request
ReadTimeout.description_zh: 请求的 read 超时时间

items.description_en: The specified custom request header field
items.description_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段

Retry.description_en:
Indicates whether WAF retries when back-to-origin fails. Valid values:

true: WAF retries.

false: WAF does not retry
Retry.description_zh:
WAF回源失败时，是否重试。取值：

true：表示重试。

false：表示不重试

RoutingRules.description_en:
The hybrid cloud forwarding rules, expressed as a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a structure that contains the following fields:
rs: Array type
RoutingRules.description_zh:
混合云转发规则。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：
rs：Array类型

SniEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether back-to-origin Server Name Indication (SNI) is enabled. Valid values:

true: Back-to-origin SNI is enabled.

false: Back-to-origin SNI is not enabled
SniEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启回源SNI。取值：

true：表示开启回源SNI。

false：表示不开启回源SNI

SniHost.description_en:
The custom value of the SNI extension field. If the value is empty, the SNI value is not customized, and the value of the Host field in the request header is used as the SNI extension field value by default.

This parameter is returned only when SniStatus is set to 1, which indicates that back-to-origin SNI is enabled
SniHost.description_zh:
SNI扩展字段的自定义值。取值为空表示未自定义SNI值，默认使用请求头中Host字段的值作为SNI扩展字段的值。

仅在SniStatus取值为1（表示开启SNI回源）时，返回该参数

WriteTimeout.description_en: The write timeout period. Unit: milliseconds
